name: The Bog
description: Perfectly circular black pool in the woods of the Kessig Approaches on Innistrad, feared by the forest's terrors and home to an ancient entity.

description_citations.text: "The Bog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Entity of the Bog resides there for centuries, tying the villagers' souls to it.
timeline.quote: It seeped into the souls of the villagers and tied them to it.

citation.text: "The Bog", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Merlinde arrives, looks into the Bog and finds something terrible, vast and ancient.
timeline.quote: There, she found something terrible, vast, and ancient.
